mapper.sql: id, provider_code, market_code, provider_sector_id, taxonomy_version, sector_name, valid_from, valid_to, archived, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO market_sector_identity_lock (provider_code, market_code, provider_sector_id) VALUES (#{providerCode}, #{marketCode}, #{providerSectorId})

INSERT INTO market_sector_identity (provider_code, market_code, provider_sector_id, taxonomy_version, sector_name, valid_from, valid_to, archived) VALUES (#{providerCode}, #{marketCode}, #{providerSectorId}, #{taxonomyVersion}, #{sectorName}, #{validFrom}, #{validTo}, #{archived})
mapper.update: UPDATE market_sector_identity SET archived = TRUE WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM market_sector_identity WHERE market_code = #{marketCode} AND archived = FALSE ORDER BY provider_sector_id, taxonomy_version
mapper.update: UPDATE market_sector_snapshot SET sector_identity_id = ( SELECT i.id FROM market_sector_identity i INNER JOIN market_sector_watch w ON i.provider_code = w.provider_code AND i.provider_sector_id = w.provider_sector_id WHERE w.id = market_sector_snapshot.watch_id AND i.market_code = #{marketCode} AND i.archived = FALSE LIMIT 1 ) WHERE sector_identity_id IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM market_sector_watch w WHERE w.id = market_sector_snapshot.watch_id AND w.market_code = #{marketCode} )

UPDATE market_sector_member_snapshot SET sector_identity_id = ( SELECT i.id FROM market_sector_identity i INNER JOIN market_sector_watch w ON i.provider_code = w.provider_code AND i.provider_sector_id = w.provider_sector_id INNER JOIN market_sector_snapshot s ON s.watch_id = w.id WHERE s.id = market_sector_member_snapshot.snapshot_id AND i.market_code = #{marketCode} AND i.archived = FALSE LIMIT 1 ) WHERE sector_identity_id IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM market_sector_snapshot s INNER JOIN market_sector_watch w ON s.watch_id = w.id WHERE s.id = market_sector_member_snapshot.snapshot_id AND w.market_code = #{marketCode} )
